features.name: Robust reading
features.description: Non-UTF-8 encoding / BOM / missing folder: clear message, never a traceback, the audit goes on.

features.name: Fingerprint registry + fine-grained analysis
features.description: agents-common.versions.json (version -> sha256); states up to date / behind / hand-edited / ahead / invalid markers; version [--register] command.

features.name: Safe sync + diff
features.description: sync refuses local edits and downgrades without --force, writes nothing if up to date, --dry-run; check --diff; an unregistered canon is never distributed.

features.name: audit: exclusions + mixed generated blocks + --strict
features.description: .agents-kit-ignore / --exclude; Next.js/OpenSpec file with project content = to migrate; --strict for CI.

features.name: adopt command
features.description: Inserts the common block into an existing AGENTS.md without losing anything (previous content kept in §7), leading generated block preserved.

features.name: ledger command
features.description: Read-only lint of the 4 state files per §2 (JSON, statuses, ids, log format/budget/rotation, 15-30 criteria).

features.name: Tests + CI
features.description: Standard-library unittest + GitHub Actions (Ubuntu/Windows): tests, kit and template check, registered version.

features.name: Documentation
features.description: README, docstring, AGENTS.md §7, MIGRATION.md updated with the new commands.

features.name: Tests independent of the canon version
features.description: Tests derive the current canon version instead of hardcoding "v1.0": a version bump must break no test.

features.name: Canon v1.1
features.description: Priority of instructions, untouchable block (lessons in §7), ledger proportionality, contract lifecycle, closure, encoding, destructive git, external content, tests never weakened, pinned tools.

features.name: v1.1 propagation and documentation
features.description: Registry, template, kit AGENTS.md, ledger template, README, MIGRATION, CHANGELOG.

features.name: Script and tests in English
features.description: Identifiers, docstrings, comments, CLI flags and messages, state labels; legacy agents-commun markers still recognized so sync can migrate the fleet.

features.name: Canon v2.0 in English
features.description: agents-common.md with agents-common markers, registry renamed and extended, template and kit AGENTS.md resynced.

features.name: Docs and ledger history in English
features.description: README, CHANGELOG, MIGRATION, audit, token measurement, journal archives, feature archive, log, CI, .gitattributes.

features.name: English regression guard and token re-measurement
features.description: Test failing on French characters or French file names in tracked files; v2.0 token count measured.

features.name: skills import (add/list)
features.description: scripts/skills_agents.py: fetch a skill folder from a GitHub tarball (stdlib only), vendor it under skills/<name>/, registry skills.json (source, sha, fingerprints).

features.name: skills deploy (sync/check)
features.description: Install/update <repo>/.agents/skills/<name>/ + lock .agents/skills/.agents-kit.json; refusals on hand-edited files without --force; --dry-run; per-skill granularity.

features.name: skills audit (fleet)
features.description: Sweep every <root>/<repo>/.agents/skills against the kit: up to date / behind / hand-edited / none; --strict, --exclude, .agents-kit-ignore.

features.name: Offline tests
features.description: unittest suite with mocked GitHub seam (in-memory tarball): import, registry, refusals, lock, update, prune, audit, encoding guards.

features.name: Docs and first skill
features.description: README section, CHANGELOG entry, kit AGENTS.md §7 commands + invariants; vendor using-superpowers (obra/superpowers) through the real path and sync a simulated consumer repo.
